description: GNSS - Grønland is the dataset of observation files from the Greenland GNSS network (GNET), a set of permanent satellite navigation reference stations along the coast of Greenland, distributed by the Danish Agency for Climate Data on its Dataforsyningen portal. The data description read on 2026-09-28 explains that the stations tie Greenland's reference network to European and global reference frames, are used to measure the land's movement and to post-process surveys such as drone flights and geodetic measurements, and that files come in RINEX 2 format up to 31 December 2021 and RINEX 3 from 1 January 2022, at 1-second and 30-second sampling with navigation files, Hatanaka-compressed in daily files; updates are continuous. Coverage is the Greenland coast. Access is free by FTP after the usual Dataforsyningen login; the terms state the CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: station lists and outages are not given on the page, and polar ionospheric conditions affect data quality. It supports resilience studies of satellite positioning services, for example space weather effects on GNSS in the Arctic. No related Greenland positioning record is catalogued; national CORS records for other countries complement it.
